content.title: Visits at CIME Nairobi: Strengthening Partnerships and Collaboration
content.summary: CIME recently hosted important visits with MP Shah Hospital and Linedata that underscore ongoing collaborations and potential partnerships.

content.text: CIME Nairobi recently hosted important visits that underscore ongoing collaborations and potential partnerships.

Firstly, Sister Eunice Bett, Principal of the Nursing School at MP Shah Hospital, along with her colleagues, visited CIME to discuss a forthcoming Memorandum of Understanding between AKU and MP Shah Hospital. The collaboration will include the use of Visually Enhanced Mental Simulation (VEMS) as a cost-effective method for training non-technical skills.

In another visit, a delegation from Linedata, a global financial technology, services, and solutions provider, toured CIME Nairobi. Linedata has been a key sponsor of AKU's initiatives in Kampala. During their visit, they had an unexpected encounter with a simulated emergency scenario, where the team successfully revived a "patient" named Dan, in honor of one of the rescuers. This visit provided a glimpse into the kind of impactful work that will take place at the upcoming University Centre in Kampala.
